decision_rule.quick_smoke_pass_if: M3234 interface pricing is positive, frozen v2 held-out-family train coverage is 1.0, required rare validation probes are present, all quick demos replay successfully, interface target artifact is written, tail reconstruction MSE <= 1e-12, tail max absolute error <= 1e-6, at least 200 tail frames are encoded, and no policy checkpoint is written.
decision_rule.next_training_admission: A pass admits only a separate tail-family interface pretrain design/quick milestone. It does not admit full C1 training or C2.
